description: Defines a final class MappedOutcome that implements the MappingOutcome interface. It encapsulates mapping results including an identifier, mapped data, topic path, and an optional external message. Provides an accept method for visitor pattern invocation.

classes.name: MappedOutcome
classes.description: A final, package-private class encapsulating the result of a mapping operation with visitor pattern support.

methods.name: MappedOutcome
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mapping outcome with identifier, mapped data, topic path, and optional external message.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Implements visitor pattern; calls the appropriate method on the visitor based on outcome, handling exceptions.
